external_entities.name: duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who uses the dispatch console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.
external_entities.notes: How an engineer signs in to the dispatch console was not written down.

external_entities.name: scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.notes: How the partner identifies the importer was not written down.

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript app used by duty engineers.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: How an engineer signs in to it was not written down. The console and API are served from different origins.

processes.name: corporate web host
processes.description: The host that serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
processes.notes: The API is not reachable from the internet. CORS origins and credential allowance were not recorded.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: A process that pulls, parses, archives and posts planned work.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: It presents an API token issued when it was built; nobody has rotated that token since.

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: Database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: How the database is protected at rest was not written down anywhere.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder containing downloaded XML documents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_stores.notes: The archive is a folder on the corporate file store.

data_stores.name: corporate file store
data_stores.description: The file store containing the schedule archive.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The console and API are served from different origins, so the API answers the console cross-origin. Allowed origins and credential handling were not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The console opens and holds a WebSocket to receive live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: Whether the socket uses TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, and whether it rechecks the engineer's session were not written down.

data_flows.name: read and write records
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads from and writes to the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: pull planned work
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the partner's planned-work SOAP feed.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: How the partner identifies the importer and how the importer identifies the partner were not written down.
data_flows.data_description: tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: write schedule document
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The importer presents an API token. The token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers sit and the schedule importer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate and authority to move crews or change depot work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: A corporate laptop holds none of the rights held by an account in this zone. The zone is not reachable from the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database's contents make its data classification confidential.
assumptions.basis: The database holds job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and tokens or sessions.

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch API presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The API answers the browser-based dispatch console cross-origin.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule importer presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is an hourly importer that pulls, parses, archives, and posts work rather than presenting a web application interface.
